fields.navigationTitle: Now Serving: Income That Cannot Be Outlived
fields.metaDescription: In tennis, every point starts with a serve. For retirement plans, success starts with execution.

fields.heading: Now serving: Guaranteed income for life

fields.body:
World No 1. tennis player and Allianz global brand ambassador Jannik Sinner knows that championship success isn’t defined by a single shot – it’s built through meticulous preparation, composed precision, and disciplined execution.

Retirement planning isn’t so different.

As lifetime income becomes a valuable component of defined contribution plans, you and your clients may need solutions engineered to go the distance. That is why we designed Allianz Lifetime Income+® Annuity, an in-plan fixed index annuity (FIA) that bridges the gap between asset protection and growth potential. By providing guaranteed lifetime income alongside growth opportunities, it offers participants a modern strategy designed to go the distance.

Because success, whether on the court or in retirement, shouldn’t be left to chance.

fields.heading: A changed game calls for a new strategy
fields.body:
Rising concerns around volatility, longevity, and inflation have reshaped what participants need from their retirement strategies – and what financial professionals and plan sponsors are being asked to deliver.

And the urgency is growing:

  • Accelerating demand: Demographic changes are creating a growing need for guaranteed lifetime income solutions.
  • Gaps in traditional tools: Traditional retirement models are disappearing, leaving standard defined contribution plans to do the heavy lifting for income needs
  • Complex economic conditions: Persistent market volatility can require a more structured approach to risk management

Saving alone may no longer be enough. To help secure the long game, participants may need an adaptable solution that converts some of their accumulated savings into lifetime income they can’t outlive – all while maintaining the flexibility and portability that modern workforces demand.

fields.heading: Mastering risk
fields.body:
In tennis, a great serve can win points, but a flawless baseline defense can win championships.

Most DC plan investments are exposed to market volatility. With Allianz Lifetime Income+®, however, contributions and credited interest remain protected from downturns.

That means that even when markets decline, the annuity portion of participants’ retirement assets doesn’t – providing an added layer of defense when it matters most.

fields.heading: Capturing opportunity
fields.body:
Preparation isn’t just about managing uncertainty. It’s about being ready when opportunity appears.

Allianz Lifetime Income+® offers more than protection. It combines guaranteed lifetime income with growth potential tied to the performance of external market indexes, up to a cap or other limiter.

It’s a balanced approach that helps participants continue pursuing future income growth while managing compounding risk.

fields.heading: In it for the long game
fields.body:
Successful outcomes aren’t built on a single moment – they’re built over time.

Allianz Lifetime Income+® offers guaranteed retirement income that cannot be outlived.

And because long-term strategies deserve long-term strength, it’s backed by the financial strength and stability of Allianz Life Insurance Company of North America,1 rated the #1 Annuity Company of 2026 by Forbes.2

fields.heading: The ultimate team player
fields.body:
When it’s time to execute, coordination is everything. Allianz Lifetime Income+® is built to work seamlessly within an employer-sponsored plan without adding unnecessary operational friction:

  • No additional charge for sponsors: Deliver meaningful value to participants – without adding another line item for the sponsor.
  • Intuitive education: Digital calculators, interactive tools, and educational videos are delivered smoothly within the familiar recordkeeper experience
  • Participant focused features: Combines guaranteed lifetime income and growth potential with the flexibility and portability participants may need
  • Managed account integration: Integrates seamlessly with managed accounts to support personalized, professional oversight for income decisions

Because when experience and education work together, financial professionals can spend less time navigating complexity – and more time helping clients prepare for retirement.

fields.heading: The ball’s in your court
fields.body: Outmaneuver today’s retirement planning challenges with a solution that delivers competitive value to plan sponsors, while providing participants with the resilience to go the distance.
